description: This file provides utility functions to generate various dialog configurations for Mattermost's Cypress end-to-end tests, including dialogs with different input elements, multi-step forms, dynamic and static date/time pickers, and timezone/manual entry demos.

methods.name: createDialog
methods.description: Constructs a base dialog object with provided trigger ID, webhook URL, and dialog configuration.

methods.name: createFormResponse
methods.description: Creates a form response structure based on form configuration.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Generates a form element object with specified type and configuration.
